legend: You are given an integer a$$$a$$$. Find the smallest positive integer b$$$b$$$ (b≥1$$$b \ge 1$$$) such that a+b$$$a+b$$$ is a divisor of a⋅b$$$a \cdot b$$$.

The first line of each testcase contains one integer a$$$a$$$ (2≤a≤109$$$2 \le a \le 10^9$$$).
output: For each testcase, print the smallest integer b≥1$$$b \ge 1$$$ such that a+b$$$a+b$$$ is a divisor of a⋅b$$$a \cdot b$$$.
